neighborhoods.name: Tafuna
neighborhoods.description: American Samoa's largest village (7,988 people in the 2020 census), a flat residential and commercial spread on the Tafuna Plain next to Pago Pago International Airport
neighborhoods.character: Largest village, flat plain, airport adjacent, stores and churches, growing

housing.predominantType: Single-family homes with a modest supply of small apartment blocks

neighborhoods.character_notes: The most practical base on Tutuila for a renter: the flattest terrain on the island, the biggest grocery stores, and Pago Pago International Airport — the Hawaiian Airlines link to Honolulu — all close by, and what formal apartment stock the territory has is concentrated here. Because about 90% of American Samoa's land is communal and cannot be alienated to anyone of less than half Samoan blood, non-Samoan retirees rent or take long leases (max 55 years with government approval) rather than buy — buy prices are simply not applicable. Aiga buses run the Tafuna-Fagatogo route on weekdays; LBJ Tropical Medical Center in Faga'alu is roughly 15-20 minutes by road.

neighborhoods.name: Ottoville
neighborhoods.description: A flat subdivision of Tafuna known for the Holy Family Catholic Cathedral, Ottoville Rainforest Park, and a growing strip of shops and offices
neighborhoods.character: Suburban, cathedral, rainforest park, commercial growth, orderly
neighborhoods.character_notes: One of the few parts of the territory with subdivision-style housing rather than village compounds, which makes it the easiest place for an outsider to find a conventional rental — at the top of the Tafuna price range. The terrain is completely flat and the lowland rainforest park offers shaded walking, a real asset in the constant heat and humidity. Airport, clinics, and pharmacies are minutes away; the hospital run to LBJ in Faga'alu is about 20 minutes.

neighborhoods.name: Ili'ili
neighborhoods.description: A quiet residential village on the inland Tafuna Plain, home to the territory's only golf course, the 18-hole Lava Lava Golf Course
neighborhoods.character: Residential, golf course, quiet, inland plain, family oriented
neighborhoods.character_notes: The retiree draw is the Lava Lava Golf Course — cheap greens fees and the only course in the territory — plus quieter, slightly cheaper living than central Tafuna. It is car-dependent: aiga buses serving the plain are less frequent than the harbor routes and stop by late afternoon, with none on Sunday, when village church observance shapes the whole day. Shops in Tafuna are 5-10 minutes away and LBJ Tropical Medical Center about 20-25 minutes.

neighborhoods.name: Nu'uuli
neighborhoods.description: American Samoa's second-largest village (4,991 in 2020), a busy commercial strip along the main road between the Tafuna Plain and Pago Pago Harbor
neighborhoods.character: Commercial strip, busy road, shops and services, central, convenient

housing.predominantType: Family homes behind the commercial strip; occasional apartments above shops

neighborhoods.character_notes: The most convenient errands location on the island — hardware stores, groceries, banks, and eateries line Route 1, and every Tafuna-Fagatogo aiga bus passes through — but the strip is traffic-heavy with patchy sidewalks, so walking it takes care. Rentals appear by word of mouth and on local bulletin boards more than any formal listing service; stock is genuinely scarce and turnover slow. Sitting midway between the airport and the hospital, LBJ Tropical Medical Center is only about 10 minutes away.
